style.backgroundSystem: flat cobalt claim field #2F6BB0 for typographic and spec screens, deep cocoa stage #6B4230 for product and ingredient screens, cool near-white studio sweep #F7F6F4 for packshots and blank proof panels
style.iconSystem: flat thin-line pictograms in cobalt #2F6BB0 plus empty seal, shield and button outlines only, no real certification marks and no award laurels
style.lightingSystem: bright even high-key neutral-cool studio light, front-left softbox key with bounce fill, soft contact shadows grounding every unit, one controlled highlight on each cap, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent bold athletic ready-to-drink dairy visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of a cool near-white studio field #F7F6F4, a flat cobalt claim field #2F6BB0, a deep cocoa stage #6B4230 and one lime-green hairline accent #A8C93B; bright even high-key neutral-cool studio lighting with a front-left softbox key, bounce fill, soft contact shadows and one controlled highlight on the cap; matte cocoa laminate stage and blank unprinted panel stock #FBFAF9 as surfaces; one heavy condensed geometric sans-serif headline band with small geometric sans labels, all wording carried only as placeholders; flat thin-line pictograms and empty seal, shield and button outlines in cobalt; the upright bottle held at full height with a stable hero angle and fixed scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no real certification or award marks, no readable digits or barcodes.
noDrift: no real certification or award marks
no readable digits, barcodes or pack counts anywhere
style.presentationRules: the upright bottle keeps full height, a stable hero angle and one fixed scale across the set, front label plane always turned to camera and never covered by props or hands
style.surfaceSystem: matte cocoa laminate stage #6B4230, cool near-white studio sweep #F7F6F4, blank unprinted panel stock #FBFAF9
style.typography: one heavy condensed geometric sans-serif headline band with small geometric sans labels, every wording carried as a placeholder and never as readable copy
